name: AutomaTuner
description: A Python tool that automates packaging and deploying applications from the Winget repository into Microsoft Intune using WinTuner. Features automated packaging, direct publishing, dependency handling, duplicate detection, and report generation with Azure AD authentication.
keywords: how to deploy winget apps to intune
author: Ayoub Sekoum

securityCheck.aiSummary: The code is largely legitimate for Intune/endpoint management (dependency installation, Windows component setup, and PowerShell module management). No obfuscated logic, no credential harvesting, no data exfiltration, and no hardcoded secrets detected. The primary security concern is reliance on external package sources for installation; mitigate with integrity checks, trusted sources, repository pinning, and signing of modules. Consider adding verification of downloaded content and a restricted, signed module policy to reduce risk from compromised packages.
